hooks.name: Setup Dev Environment
hooks.description: Re-runs the full setup: rebuilds .venv if needed, reinstalls requirements, asks for the dev-mode router IP/username/password, and tests the connection. Not needed on a fresh clone — the Check Environment session-start hook already does the venv and dependency part automatically.

action.prompt: Read `.kiro/steering/setup.md` and follow it end to end. That file is the single source of truth for the setup flow — do not improvise a different sequence.
